verdicts.Company: Distribuidora Industrial de Adhesivos S.A. de C.V.
verdicts.reason: Confirmed active technical distributor of industrial consumables representing MG Chemicals electronic potting and encapsulation compounds.
Technical distributor and wholesaler of heavy industrial electronics insulation systems, including Elantas formulated polyurethane and epoxy casting/potting resins.
Active specialized distributor of specialty chemicals, distributing Henkel Loctite, DOWSIL, and Parker LORD chemical potting materials and liquid encapsulants.
Official specialist distributor of Momentive silicone technologies in Spain, including Snapsil dielectric potting gels and RTV silicones.
Technical distributor of industrial assembly polymers and electronic-grade potting compounds, including Robnor ResinLab polyurethane and epoxy potting formulations.
Active technical distributor providing circuit insulation protection and supply logistics for Fujipoly specialized thermal encapsulation gels and electronic potting compounds.
Active logistics and distribution company supplying third-party synthetic resins, polyurethane and epoxy resin bases for casting and encapsulation formulations.
Global distribution partner for specialty chemical solutions, offering synthetic resins and polymer bases for potting components made by others.

The company is a wholesale distributor of chemical raw materials and industrial supplies (construction, paints, varnishes, fiberglass reinforcements), but lacks any confirmed footprint in the specialized electronic potting and encapsulation compounds market.

A general online and offline distributor of industrial chemicals, lab reagents, and swimming pool treatments, but does not specialize in or explicitly distribute electronic-grade potting and encapsulation compounds.

The company is explicitly a manufacturer as well as a distributor of specialty chemical systems, including RTV silicone and epoxy resins for technical casting and encapsulation, which excludes them under the 'DROP makers and their subsidiaries' rule.

A dedicated third-party distributor and stockist of specialty chemical materials that distributes electronic potting and encapsulation compounds manufactured by others (such as Henkel Stycast and DOWSIL).
An authorized distributor of third-party technical adhesives and electronic encapsulants/potting compounds (such as Huntsman Araldite and CHT Silicones) serving Ireland and Northern Ireland.

verdicts.Company: Plastiformas de México, S.A. de C.V.
verdicts.reason: An official regional trading house and distributor of third-party polymer systems, supplying Smooth-On liquid polyurethane and flexible silicone potting and encapsulating resins.

A dedicated specialty chemical logistics and distribution partner that stocks and supplies third-party high-performance epoxy, polyurethane, and silicone electronic potting resins (such as Huntsman Advanced Materials).

A multi-generational chemical distributor that acts as an official distribution partner for major brands like WACKER and Parker LORD, stocking their electronic potting resins and protective silicone casting systems.

Distrelec is a prominent high-service catalog distributor of electronic and technical components across Europe, selling third-party potting and encapsulation brands like RS PRO and Electrolube. It was acquired by RS Group.

The company distributes industrial raw materials, specialty additives, and base resins for coatings and paints (representing brands like BYK and Alberdingk Boley), rather than selling finished electronic potting and encapsulation compounds to the electronics assembly market.

Megatron AG acts as a stockholding technical distributor and principal representative for major manufacturing brands, supplying ready-to-use potting compounds (Giessharze/Vergussmasse) alongside magnetic cores and electronic isolation materials.

ECSA Chemicals is a broad-line wholesale chemical distributor that trades bulk base chemical raw materials, solvents, glycols, and formulation ingredients, rather than selling finished electronic potting and encapsulation compounds.
